notes:
Summary: Enterprise financial services group evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing and internal LLM features. Primary ask: strict key control (BYOK + HSM-backed keys), EU data residency, auditable key usage and long-term log retention.

Key technical requirements:
- Customer-managed keys across AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS; must support BYOK import and key rotation policies.
- HSM attestation required (FIPS 140-2/140-3 or equivalent); need vendor attestation docs and remote attestation flow for keys used in inference.
- Envelope encryption model: application layer wraps with CMK; Redwood must accept encrypted model artifacts and accept wrapped token for runtime decryption.
- Detailed audit logs forwarded to our Splunk instance; retention 7 years; immutable storage preferred.
- Data residency: all inference cache and KV store must reside in EU regions (specific: eu-west-1 / europe-west1) and not be replicated outside without approval.
- Role separation: SRE and Security teams require separate KMS access roles; integration must support granular IAM mapping and audit trail per key use.

Timeline & recent activity:
- 2025-11-06: Initial inbound via website; AE outreach (Maya) — qualification call scheduled.
- 2026-01-28: Architecture deep-dive (Fireflies ff_2026-01-28_0930) — SE demo of VPC topology and KMS options; asked for HSM attestation path.
- 2026-02-11: Security team questionnaire submitted; follow-up call reviewed envelope encryption assumptions (ff_2026-02-11_1400).
- 2026-02-25: Legal requested vendor SOC2/ISO artifacts; Redwood provided SOC2 Type II and KMS design doc.
- 2026-03-03: POC scoping doc shared (drive link); request for BYOK import instructions for AWS/Azure/GCP.
- 2026-03-08: Internal procurement signaled interest pending HSM attestation timeline.

POC goals:
- Provision private VPC cluster in eu-west-1 with customer-managed CMK in AWS and test envelope decryption latency (target < 15ms added per request).
- Validate audit log streaming to Splunk and confirm retention/immutability.
- Execute key rotation workflow and confirm zero downtime fallback to Redwood-managed key in emergency mode.
- Demonstrate cross-cloud key import for Azure Key Vault and GCP KMS in sandbox.

Security review notes (from SE/SEC review):
- Need whitepaper describing runtime key usage (where keys are loaded, ephemeral key material handling, whether keys ever leave HSM boundary).
- Clarify customer key lifecycle: creation, import, rotation, revocation, emergency key compromise process.
- Request for HSM attestation certificate and remote challenge/response proof-of-possession flow.
- Confirm support for Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) tooling and steps to rotate keys without requiring redeploy of model artifacts.

Commercial & procurement points:
- Interested in private deployment license + support tier; pricing sensitivity around required HSM feature add-on (~estimated $ per-month charge). Looking for a clear add-on SKU for HSM/BYOK.

Quotes from customer:
- "We can't accept keys we don't control — need proof of HSM-backed key usage and a way to rotate without service interruption."

Next steps (short):
- AE (Maya) to deliver HSM attestation checklist and timelines by 2026-03-14.
- SE (Arjun) to schedule hands-on BYOK import session (2h POC) week of 2026-03-22.
- Security to open joint Jira SEC-4127 for audit log schema confirmation.

Blockers (short):
- HSM attestation and timing from Redwood.
- Procurement sign-off on HSM add-on cost.
- Legal review of KMS SLA and data residency guarantees.

Internal flags: high-touch enterprise — assign CSM early if deal progresses. Recommended exec sponsor: Head of Information Security (customer) requires CISO-level meeting prior to contract signature.
